text_en: In the eighteenth year, on the twenty-second day of the first month, there was talk in the palace of Nebuchadnezzar, king of the Assyrians, about carrying out his revenge on the whole region, just as he had said.
text_cn: 十八年正月二十二日，在亚述王拿步高宫内，举行会议，商讨如何依照王的吩咐，向各国复仇雪恨之事。

text_en: He summoned all his ministers and all his nobles and set before them his secret plan and recounted fully, with his own lips, all the wickedness of the region.
text_cn: 君王召集了所有的臣仆和公卿，向他们说明自己暗怀的心愿，决意亲口下令灭绝那些国家；

text_en: They decided that every one who had not obeyed his command should be destroyed.
text_cn: 大家一致表决，凡不听从君王号召的人，都应铲除。

text_en: When he had completed his plan, Nebuchadnezzar, king of the Assyrians, called Holofernes, the chief general of his army, second only to himself, and said to him,
text_cn: 开会议决后，亚述王拿步高就将他的总司令，兼居全国次位的敖罗斐乃召来， 对他说：

text_en: “Thus says the Great King, the lord of the whole earth: Leave my presence and take with you men confident in their strength, one hundred twenty thousand foot soldiers and twelve thousand cavalry.
text_cn: “大王，全世界之主这样说： 看，你应离我出征，率领骁勇善战的人，步兵十二万，一万二千战马及骑士，

text_en: March out against all the land to the west, because they disobeyed my orders.
text_cn: 去攻打西方各国，因为他们没有听从我的命令；

text_en: Tell them to prepare earth and water, for I am coming against them in my anger, and will cover the whole face of the earth with the feet of my troops, to whom I will hand them over to be plundered.
text_cn: 通知他们准备好山河， 因为我要满怀盛怒来攻打他们，以我军的脚掌，遮遍他们的地面，使他们遭受浩劫，

text_en: Their wounded shall fill their ravines and gullies, and the swelling river shall be filled with their dead.
text_cn: 使伤者填满沟壑，死者充塞江河，致使河水泛滥。

text_en: I will lead them away captive to the ends of the whole earth.
text_cn: 将他们的俘虏，放逐到大地四极。

text_en: You shall go and seize all their territory for me in advance. They must yield themselves to you, and you shall hold them for me until the day of their punishment.
text_cn: 今你出征，首先代我占据那所有的领土；如果人自愿向你请降，你就给我保留，等惩治他们的日子来到。

text_en: But to those who resist show no mercy, but hand them over to slaughter and plunder throughout your whole region.
text_cn: 对不投降的，你的眼不用顾惜，在你占领区内，任人屠杀抢掠。

text_en: For as I live, and by the power of my kingdom, what I have spoken I will accomplish by my own hand.
text_cn: 我既以我的性命作担保，以帝国的权威下令，也必亲手执行。

text_en: And you—take care not to transgress any of your lord’s commands, but carry them out exactly as I have ordered you; do it without delay. ”
text_cn: 至于你，不可违犯你主上的任何命令，但应照我吩咐你的，尽心办理，切勿怠慢！”

text_en: So Holofernes left the presence of his lord, and summoned all the commanders, generals, and officers of the Assyrian army.
text_cn: 敖罗斐乃辞别主上出来，就召集亚述的众将领、司令和武官，

text_en: He mustered the picked troops by divisions as his lord had ordered him to do, one hundred twenty thousand of them, together with twelve thousand archers on horseback,
text_cn: 依照主上所命的，数点了出征的精兵，约十二万人，骑兵射手一万二千，

text_en: and he organized them as a great army is marshaled for a campaign.
text_cn: 将他们分编成为作战的队伍。

text_en: He took along a vast number of camels and donkeys and mules for transport, and innumerable sheep and oxen and goats for food;
text_cn: 后又牵来许多骆驼驴骡，载运辎重，赶来无数的绵羊、牛和山羊，充当军需；

text_en: also ample rations for everyone, and a huge amount of gold and silver from the royal palace.
text_cn: 又给众人分发了大批给养，再由王库，支取了大批的金银，

text_en: Then he set out with his whole army, to go ahead of King Nebuchadnezzar and to cover the whole face of the earth to the west with their chariots and cavalry and picked foot soldiers.
text_cn: 然后率领大军出发，作拿步高王的先锋，以战车马队和精兵，遮蔽西方的地面。

text_en: Along with them went a mixed crowd like a swarm of locusts, like the dust of the earth—a multitude that could not be counted.
text_cn: 另有很多混合的军人，多如蝗虫尘沙，也跟随出征，人数众多，无法统计。

text_en: They marched for three days from Nineveh to the plain of Bectileth, and camped opposite Bectileth near the mountain that is to the north of Upper Cilicia.
text_cn: 他们出了尼尼微城，行军三日，到了贝克提肋特平原，便靠近贝克提肋特，在上基里基雅北边的山岭安营。

text_en: From there Holofernes took his whole army, the infantry, cavalry, and chariots, and went up into the hill country.
text_cn: 敖罗斐乃后又率领大军：步兵、骑兵、战车，由那里往山地进发，

text_en: He ravaged Put and Lud, and plundered all the Rassisites and the Ishmaelites on the border of the desert, south of the country of the Chelleans.
text_cn: 击败了普特和路得， 掠夺了辣息斯的众子民，以及住在赫肋人以南的旷野对面的依市玛耳子民。

text_en: Then he followed the Euphrates and passed through Mesopotamia and destroyed all the fortified towns along the brook Abron, as far as the sea.
text_cn: 渡过幼发拉的河，穿过美索不达米亚，破坏了沿哈波尔河至海一带的坚城。

text_en: He also seized the territory of Cilicia, and killed everyone who resisted him. Then he came to the southern borders of Japheth, facing Arabia.
text_cn: 以后占领了基里基雅的地方，粉碎一切抵抗，来到位于阿剌伯对面南部的雅敖斐特边境，

text_en: He surrounded all the Midianites, and burned their tents and plundered their sheepfolds.
text_cn: 围攻了米德杨的众子民，焚毁了他们的帐幕，劫夺了他们的羊圈。

text_en: Then he went down into the plain of Damascus during the wheat harvest, and burned all their fields and destroyed their flocks and herds and sacked their towns and ravaged their lands and put all their young men to the sword.
text_cn: 到了收割麦子的时候，便下到大马士革平原，放火烧田，搜杀牛羊，劫掠城市，破坏庄田，刀斩青年。

text_en: So fear and dread of him fell upon all the people who lived along the seacoast, at Sidon and Tyre, and those who lived in Sur and Ocina and all who lived in Jamnia. Those who lived in Azotus and Ascalon feared him greatly.
text_cn: 因此，凡住在海边、漆冬、提洛、稣尔、敖基纳、雅木尼雅的人都战兢害怕，阿左托及阿市刻隆各地的居民，对他更是万分恐惧害怕。
